name: Identify 'dormant' customers who haven't purchased since July 2010.
python_code:
# Identify dormant customers who haven't purchased since July 2010
# First, convert InvoiceDate to datetime
df['InvoiceDate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['InvoiceDate'])

# Filter out rows with missing Customer ID
df_valid = df.dropna(subset=['Customer ID']).copy()

# Find the last purchase date for each customer
last_purchase = df_valid.groupby('Customer ID')['InvoiceDate'].max().reset_index()
last_purchase.columns = ['Customer ID', 'LastPurchaseDate']

# Define the cutoff date (end of July 2010)
cutoff_date = pd.Timestamp('2010-07-31 23:59:59')

# Identify dormant customers (last purchase on or before July 2010)
dormant_customers = last_purchase[last_purchase['LastPurchaseDate'] <= cutoff_date]

# Store the result as a DataFrame with Customer ID and their last purchase date
result = dormant_customers[['Customer ID', 'LastPurchaseDate']].copy()
